prompt: Edit @Video1, changing ONLY the motion of the four existing people. This is the settled Paris scene's quiet idle animation, NOT a construction or loading sequence. Preserve the original locked camera, composition, architecture, café furniture, lamps, sign, pavement fragments, black surround, blue/magenta/off-white point and glyph overlay animation, two upper-right detail panes and all typography. Do not freeze or replace the existing overlay motion. Keep the same four people, appearances, clothing, scale and depth ordering. Animate the foreground hand-holding pair with two or three small, slow, natural steps along their existing crossing direction over this ten-second shot; their total travel must remain modest and inside the central foreground, retaining the overall composition. Feet must alternately plant and lift with heel-to-toe contact, bend knees and hips coherently, transfer weight naturally and avoid sliding or walking in place. Their joined hands stay connected, free arms swing gently, and cloth follows the body subtly. Do not reverse the gait just to return to the first pose. For the two farther people near the café, add distinct restrained life: one takes a small slow step toward the entrance, the other makes a subtle weight shift and slight head/shoulder turn. Keep their rear-facing orientation and do not invent facial details. Preserve the reference's sparse/dithered material treatment on all bodies while articulating it with the bodies rather than dissolving anatomy. No extra people, duplicated limbs, teleportation, melting, foot skating, floating, body flicker, camera movement, new scene elements, moved furniture, changed labels, new panels, recoloring, added bloom or audio. Do not add tracking graphics across faces or hands. Keep all four figures identifiable throughout. Output one continuous silent edited clip of the same duration. Seamless looping is not required; prioritize coherent forward movement and a calm ending over a forced pose reset.
